# Pablo Vallejo

Pablo Vallejo is a Spanish Senior Backend Engineer with more than eight years of experience building backend systems, real-time Big Data pipelines, and high-performance services.

## Speciality and technologies

Backend engineering, architecture, observability, and production systems. Main technologies include Node.js, TypeScript, Big Data, Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, ClickHouse, BigQuery, and MariaDB.

## Experience

Experience includes founding and leading a mental-health AI platform, building real-time anomaly detection and data systems for telecommunications, renewable-energy software, and independent web projects.
